d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: bihar men in dinon ek aisi shadi ki charcha hai.... jahan dulhe ke svagat ke lie sirph phulon ki barish nahin.... balki helikoptar se aane vale mehmanon ke lie chhah helipaid taiyar kie gae hain.... ghurdaur men jitne par thar gari milegi.... aur mehmanon ki davat ke lie saikron tarah ke pakvanon ka intjam kiya gaya hai....ab aap soch rahe honge ki aakhir ye shadi kiski hai.... to janab.... ye koee raja-maharaja ki shadi nahin.... balki mokama ke bahubli vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi hai.... jiski bhavyata ne pure bihar ka dhyan apni or…
